desc: Prove the characterization of any retained Snowflake by its center, middle-layer neighbors, and available leaf counts.
Derive the threshold formula \(1+(y+1)k\) and justify why all usable middle-layer neighbors can be selected independently.
Design an \(O(N\log N)\) computation using per-vertex sorted neighbor values \(\deg(m)-1\), including handling \(x,y\ge1\).
Implement adjacency construction, evaluate the best Snowflake size for every possible center, and output \(N-\text{best}\) with efficient memory usage.
Validate the implementation on samples and relevant edge cases.
